'''Double jocimers''' were a type of musical instrument use to play music of the [[Jizz/Legends|Jizz]] genre.<ref name="Slug" />

==Behind the scenes==
Double jocimers were first mentioned in the first part of ''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]'', an article published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Edward M. Erdelac]].
